infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NorCalHunt uses your high-precision GPS location to navigate refuges in the dark, mark blind and decoy waypoints, calculate exact legal shoot times, and track your walk-in path.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: NorCalHunt uses continuous background GPS tracking so your walk-in breadcrumb trail to the blind, downed bird marks, and truck return bearing stay accurate even when your phone is in your waders.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: NorCalHunt uses background location to record your walk-in trail and blind waypoints in pre-dawn conditions.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: NorCalHunt reads the compass so the map and bearing arrows point the way you are facing in the marsh.
